summary: Implemented the window title feature without running tests or repository code, as instructed. Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and a Tuple[ControlType, str] union member; rich/control.py adds the "\x1b]0;{title}\x07" format entry and Control.title classmethod with an Args docstring; rich/console.py adds set_window_title beside show_cursor, gated on is_terminal, with a Google-style docstring; rich/_windows_renderer.py adds one set_title dispatch branch. CHANGELOG.md gets an Unreleased Added bullet linking #2200 (I created the Added section since none existed). Tests added in tests/test_console.py (skipped on win32), tests/test_control.py, and tests/test_windows_renderer.py. Nothing was run, including tests and Black; verification was by reading only. Nothing committed.
